clauses.requirement: Where retro-reflective marking material of Class C, D, E or F is used, the markings shall be positioned on the outside at least once: (a) on strips at a 0.5 m distance, or (b) on areas within 100 mm x 100 mm.
Grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps in retroreflective devices shall comply with the approval marking provisions of paragraph 3.3.6 (subparagraphs 3.3.6.1 to 3.3.6.3).

Where grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps comply with the requirements of several UN Regulations, a single approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or Unique Identifier may be affixed, located anywhere on the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps, provided the conditions of 3.3.6.1.1 and 3.3.6.1.2 are met.
The single approval mark of grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps shall be visible after their installation.

No part of the grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps that transmits light shall be removable without at the same time removing the approval mark with the four to six-digit sequential number or the Unique Identifier.

The size of the components of a single approval mark shall not be less than the minimum size required for the smallest of the individual marks by the pertinent UN Regulations under which approval has been granted.
Approval marking arrangements for grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated lamps with all the additional symbols mentioned above shall follow the examples given in Annex 10 of UN R150.

Modifications of a type of retro-reflective device for motor vehicles and their trailers, and extension of approval, shall be handled in accordance with the administrative provisions of paragraph 3.4 of UN R150.
